auto_view: The JSE All Share moved +1.7% on the week to 106,428 and the rand firmed 0.5% to R17.41/$. In New York the S&P 500 moved +4.7% and the Nasdaq +6.5%, with the US 10-year at 4.92%. Commodities: gold +3.2%, platinum +2.0%, Brent -6.2%, copper +2.0%.
